integrity: All mathematical identities and the compact eigenfunction are given exactly. The included finite-parameter checker supplies corroboration only; the unbounded quantifier is established by the valuation and Laurent-factorization proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem constructs connected, simple, unweighted \(\mathbb Z\)-periodic adjacency graphs with a flat band at \(-r\) for each integer \(r\ge3\). Hopping length and degree depend on the integer parameter; this does not classify all two-site flat bands or assert a positive spectral gap above the flat-band bottom. No external independent scientific audit has been performed.
title: Every integer \(-r\), for \(r\ge3\), is a flat band of a connected two-site unweighted periodic graph
